// `Demo.Basic` — the FPP model as SysML v2 structure.
// Generated by `fpp-to-sysml` from [ local path prefix ]/tools/fpp-to-sysml/test/top/basic.fpp (fpp [version]). Do not edit: regenerate. Port types, components
// with their ports, the topology's parts and connections — what every implementation of a component must agree
// on — and each component's external contract — commands, events, telemetry channels, parameters, ids relative
// to the base id — as items of its part def. Behaviour is not in FPP and not here. Output ports are conjugated;
// a port array of size n is n ports `name_i`.
package FppGen {
    private import ScalarValues::*;

    package Types {  // the FPP types the ports and the contracts use, opaque here (their layout is FPP's)
        attribute def FwOpcodeType;  // FPP type FwOpcodeType, opaque here
        attribute def CmdArgBuffer;  // FPP type CmdArgBuffer, opaque here
        attribute def CmdResponse;  // FPP type CmdResponse, opaque here
        attribute def Sample;  // FPP type Sample, opaque here
        attribute def FwEventIdType;  // FPP type FwEventIdType, opaque here
        attribute def Time;  // FPP type Time, opaque here
        attribute def LogSeverity;  // FPP type LogSeverity, opaque here
        attribute def LogBuffer;  // FPP type LogBuffer, opaque here
        attribute def Readings;  // FPP type Readings, opaque here
        attribute def ParamBuffer;  // FPP type ParamBuffer, opaque here
        attribute def ParamValid;  // FPP type ParamValid, opaque here
        attribute def FwChanIdType;  // FPP type FwChanIdType, opaque here
        attribute def TlmBuffer;  // FPP type TlmBuffer, opaque here
    }

    package Contract {  // what the dictionary publishes about a component; ids are relative to the instance's base id
        item def Command { attribute opcode : Natural; }
        item def Event { attribute id : Natural; attribute format : String; }
        item def Channel { attribute id : Natural; }
        item def Parameter { attribute id : Natural; attribute setOpcode : Natural; attribute saveOpcode : Natural; }
    }

    port def Fw_Cmd {
        in attribute opCode : Types::FwOpcodeType;
        in attribute cmdSeq : Integer;
        inout attribute args : Types::CmdArgBuffer;
    }

    port def Fw_CmdReg {
        in attribute opCode : Types::FwOpcodeType;
    }

    port def Fw_CmdResponse {
        in attribute opCode : Types::FwOpcodeType;
        in attribute cmdSeq : Integer;
        in attribute response : Types::CmdResponse;
    }

    port def Demo_Data {
        inout attribute sample : Types::Sample;
        in attribute label : String;
    }

    port def Fw_Log {
        in attribute id : Types::FwEventIdType;
        inout attribute timeTag : Types::Time;
        in attribute severity : Types::LogSeverity;
        inout attribute args : Types::LogBuffer;
    }

    port def Demo_Query {
        in attribute readings : Types::Readings;
        out attribute result : Integer;
    }

    port def Fw_PrmGet {
        in attribute id : Integer;
        inout attribute val : Types::ParamBuffer;
        out attribute result : Types::ParamValid;
    }

    port def Fw_PrmSet {
        in attribute id : Integer;
        inout attribute val : Types::ParamBuffer;
    }

    port def Fw_LogText {
        in attribute id : Types::FwEventIdType;
        inout attribute timeTag : Types::Time;
        in attribute severity : Types::LogSeverity;
        inout attribute text : String;
    }

    port def Fw_Time {
        inout attribute time : Types::Time;
    }

    port def Fw_Tlm {
        in attribute id : Types::FwChanIdType;
        inout attribute timeTag : Types::Time;
        inout attribute val : Types::TlmBuffer;
    }

    part def Demo_Worker {  // active component Demo.Worker
        port cmdIn : Fw_Cmd;  // command recv port, async input, queue full: assert
        port cmdRegOut : ~Fw_CmdReg;  // command reg port, output
        port cmdResponseOut : ~Fw_CmdResponse;  // command resp port, output
        port dataIn_0 : Demo_Data;  // async input, queue full: drop
        port dataIn_1 : Demo_Data;  // async input, queue full: drop
        port dataOut_0 : ~Demo_Data;  // output
        port dataOut_1 : ~Demo_Data;  // output
        port eventOut : ~Fw_Log;  // event port, output
        port guardedIn : Demo_Query;  // guarded input
        port paramGetOut : ~Fw_PrmGet;  // param get port, output
        port paramSetOut : ~Fw_PrmSet;  // param set port, output
        port queryIn : Demo_Query;  // sync input
        port queryOut : ~Demo_Query;  // output
        port textEventOut : ~Fw_LogText;  // text event port, output
        port timeGetOut : ~Fw_Time;  // time get port, output
        port tlmOut : ~Fw_Tlm;  // telemetry port, output
        item cmd_START : Contract::Command {  // async, queue full drop
            attribute :>> opcode = 16;
            attribute count : Integer;
            attribute name : String;
        }
        item cmd_STOP : Contract::Command {  // sync
            attribute :>> opcode = 17;
        }
        item cmd_RESET : Contract::Command {  // guarded
            attribute :>> opcode = 18;
            attribute hard : Boolean;
        }
        item cmd_RATE_PRM_SET : Contract::Command {  // param set
            attribute :>> opcode = 32;
        }
        item cmd_RATE_PRM_SAVE : Contract::Command {  // param save
            attribute :>> opcode = 33;
        }
        item cmd_ENABLED_PRM_SET : Contract::Command {  // param set
            attribute :>> opcode = 34;
        }
        item cmd_ENABLED_PRM_SAVE : Contract::Command {  // param save
            attribute :>> opcode = 35;
        }
        item evr_Started : Contract::Event {  // activity high
            attribute :>> id = 1;
            attribute :>> format = "started {} times";
            attribute count : Integer;
        }
        item evr_Overrun : Contract::Event {  // warning low, throttle 5
            attribute :>> id = 2;
            attribute :>> format = "overrun";
        }
        item tlm_Count : Contract::Channel { attribute :>> id = 1; attribute value : Integer; }  // on change
        item tlm_Last : Contract::Channel { attribute :>> id = 2; attribute value : Types::Sample; }  // always
        item prm_Rate : Contract::Parameter { attribute :>> id = 1; attribute :>> setOpcode = 32; attribute :>> saveOpcode = 33; attribute value : Real; }  // default 1.5
        item prm_Enabled : Contract::Parameter { attribute :>> id = 2; attribute :>> setOpcode = 34; attribute :>> saveOpcode = 35; attribute value : Boolean; }  // default true
    }

    part def Demo_Sink {  // passive component Demo.Sink
        port dataIn : Demo_Data;  // sync input
        port queryOut : ~Demo_Query;  // output
    }

    part def Demo_Dispatcher {  // passive component Demo.Dispatcher
        port compCmdReg_0 : Fw_CmdReg;  // sync input
        port compCmdReg_1 : Fw_CmdReg;  // sync input
        port compCmdReg_2 : Fw_CmdReg;  // sync input
        port compCmdReg_3 : Fw_CmdReg;  // sync input
        port compCmdSend_0 : ~Fw_Cmd;  // output
        port compCmdSend_1 : ~Fw_Cmd;  // output
        port compCmdSend_2 : ~Fw_Cmd;  // output
        port compCmdSend_3 : ~Fw_Cmd;  // output
        port compCmdStat : Fw_CmdResponse;  // sync input
    }

    part def Demo_Clock {  // passive component Demo.Clock
        port timeGetPort : Fw_Time;  // sync input
    }

    part def Demo_Basic {
        part worker : Demo_Worker;  // base id 256, queue size 10
        part sink : Demo_Sink;  // base id 512
        part 'end' : Demo_Sink;  // base id 768
        part dispatcher : Demo_Dispatcher;  // base id 1024
        part clock : Demo_Clock;  // base id 1280

        connect dispatcher.compCmdSend_0 to worker.cmdIn;  // Command
        connect worker.cmdRegOut to dispatcher.compCmdReg_0;  // CommandRegistration
        connect worker.cmdResponseOut to dispatcher.compCmdStat;  // CommandResponse
        connect worker.dataOut_0 to sink.dataIn;  // Data
        connect worker.dataOut_1 to 'end'.dataIn;  // Data
        connect sink.queryOut to worker.queryIn;  // Data
        connect 'end'.queryOut to worker.guardedIn;  // Data
        connect worker.timeGetOut to clock.timeGetPort;  // Time
    }
}
